content.json:
## AgentMon Fleet — Foundry & Copilot Studio agent monitoring
Alerts written by the monitoring fleet to `AgentMonAlerts_CL`, mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10, OWASP Agentic Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.query: AgentMonAlerts_CL | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | distinct Platform | order by Platform asc

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Platform in ({Platform}) and Severity in ({Severity})
| summarize Alerts = count() by Severity
| extend Order = case(Severity == 'critical', 0, Severity == 'high', 1, Severity == 'medium', 2, Severity == 'low', 3, 4)
| order by Order asc
content.title: Alerts by severity

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Platform in ({Platform}) and Severity in ({Severity})
| summarize Alerts = count() by AlertType, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Alert types over time

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Platform in ({Platform}) and Severity in ({Severity})
| mv-expand Owasp = OwaspAgentic to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Owasp)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Owasp
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: OWASP Agentic Top 10

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Platform in ({Platform}) and Severity in ({Severity})
| summarize Alerts = count(), Critical = countif(Severity == 'critical'), High = countif(Severity == 'high'), MaxScore = max(Score), Sessions = dcount(SessionId), Types = make_set(AlertType, 8), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Agent = coalesce(AgentName, AgentId, '-'), Platform
| order by Critical desc, High desc, Alerts desc
content.title: Agents

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Platform in ({Platform}) and Severity in ({Severity})
| mv-expand Technique = MitreAtlas to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Technique
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: MITRE ATLAS techniques

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Platform in ({Platform}) and isnotempty(SessionId)
| summarize RiskScore = sum(Score), Alerts = count(), Types = make_set(AlertType, 10), Agent = take_any(coalesce(AgentName, AgentId)), User = take_any(UserId), Start = min(TimeGenerated), End = max(TimeGenerated) by SessionId
| top 25 by RiskScore desc
content.title: Riskiest sessions

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AlertType in ('BLOCKED_ACTION_WORKAROUND', 'SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_USER', 'REPEATED_BLOCKED_ATTEMPTS', 'USER_PERSISTENCE_AFTER_BLOCK', 'JAILBREAK_ATTEMPT')
| summarize Alerts = count() by AlertType, Actor = iff(AlertType in ('USER_PERSISTENCE_AFTER_BLOCK', 'JAILBREAK_ATTEMPT'), 'user', 'agent')
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: Evasion: agent workarounds vs user persistence

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, AlertName: string, AlertSeverity: string, Resource: string)[]), (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where AlertType startswith 'AI.Azure_' | project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, Resource = tostring(split(ResourceId, '/')[-1]))
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Microsoft Defender for AI alerts (AI.Azure_*)
content.noDataMessage: No Defender for AI alerts in this workspace (enable Defender for AI services and the Defender for Cloud connector).

content.query:
AgentMonAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Platform in ({Platform}) and Severity in ({Severity})
| project TimeGenerated, Severity, Score, AlertType, Agent = coalesce(AgentName, AgentId), Platform, SessionId, UserId, Summary, OwaspAgentic, MitreAtlas, IncidentId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.title: Recent alerts
